_about: How PairFree tells which brand a paired device is, before it connects (docs/DESIGN.md, Finding the earbuds). In order: a service only that brand's devices list (each brand's own code holds its services); else a whole word of the name in brand_words, for exactly one brand; else the name is exactly one of a brand's model names (Sony's names hold no brand word, so its model names are matched as Sony matches them). A name that matches not_ours, or that two brands claim, is left out rather than guessed. The model comes from the earbuds once connected wherever their protocol reports it; the name only gives the first guess. names is the test corpus: real Bluetooth names (from issues, device reports and the brands' own model lists) with the brand each must give, null for devices that are not ours, and the model where the name decides it. Every detection bug gets an entry here.
